pr_title: Validate structured authn feature is enabled for discovery url/multiple audiences
pr_body:
#### What type of PR is this?
/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Validate `StructuredAuthenticationConfiguration` feature flag is enabled when trying to set `issuer.discoveryURL` or multiple audiences in `issuer.audiences` in authentication configuration.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

-->
Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/126315

issue_context.title: `validateJWTAuthenticator` does not consistenly check `structuredAuthnFeatureEnabled`
issue_context.body:
For example, `validateIssuerDiscoveryURL` should not let you set discovery URL when the feature gate is not enabled.  I believe this only impacts library users, as direct usage in KAS requires the file based config, which is feature gated.

/assign enj aramase 
/milestone v1.32

review_comments:
this is just limiting multiple acceptable audiences on the jwt authenticator, right?

multiple accepted audiences for service account authentication have been supported via flag previously
answering my own question, yes, this is just jwt authentication
